meaning: The Model this prepaid pass is bound to.
The wallet that purchased the pass, signs `open_pass_call`, and receives any unspent escrow on `close_pass`.
Holder-chosen u64 nonce deriving the Pass PDA `["pass", model, holder, nonce_le]`.
The mint of the prepaid escrow. The default (all-zero) address means native SOL.
Discounted price per call snapshotted from `PassPlan` at purchase.
Total number of prepaid calls funded in this pass.
Number of calls opened from this pass so far.
Unspent prepaid escrow remaining in the pass (`(calls_total - calls_used) * price_per_call` while open; `0` once closed).
The slot the pass was purchased in.
The last slot `open_pass_call` may debit this pass (`purchased_slot + ttl_slots`).
